- Not free-riding completely (which would harm collective returns and others' willingness to cooperate)
- Not contributing everything (which would be exploited if others contribute nothing)
- Leaving room to adjust based on observed behavior in subsequent rounds

This positions me well whether others reciprocate cooperation or defect.
